title: ‘No debt’: Mayor Belmonte lists QC gains in State of the City Address

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — “We have fundamentally rewritten the financial story of our city,” Quezon City Mayor Maria Josefina “Joy” Belmonte said on Monday in her 2026 State of the City Address (SOCA), which she delivered before the City Council She noted that her city’s budget has more than doubled since 2019, achieved without imposing new taxes and while maintaining zero debt. It grew from around ₱22.75 billion in 2019 to ₱45.5 billion this year, with a proposed budget of ₱48.5 billion for 2027. The city has also achieved six consecutive years of Unqualified Opinions from the Commission on Audit (COA). It also […]...
